Tessa / Karthik,

Quick synopsis: Clara Jensen at Clearwave wrote back this morning — they need a short-term carveout to the standard rate tiers for a multi-product pilot across their imaging and EMR integrations. Their ask: a temporary 20% rebate on token pricing for 3 months (capped), plus a guardrail that they must migrate to our Dedicated plan if usage exceeds X. Why this matters: this is the largest inbound pilot this quarter (expected to surface 250k tokens/mo if successful) and the customer is asking to start next week. Marissa,

Forwarding Jordan's note and the attached draft memo. I put together an "exec memo" below that summarizes the rationale and recommended controls. We're specifically requesting VP/CFO signoff for a short-term, conditional carveout (20% rebate, 90-day term, hard cap of $12k gross rebate). Key guardrails included: mandatory Dedicated migration clause at >300k tokens/mo, monthly usage reporting, and immediate rollback clause if we observe quality/regression.

Executive memo (proposed):
- Customer: Clearwave Health (CLW-2025-089)
- Ask: Temporary 20% rebate to hosted token pricing for a 90-day pilot; cross-product (generation + embeddings) limited to a combined rebate cap of $12,000.
- Justification: High strategic value (integration with major imaging vendor), pilot accelerates product feedback loops and creates an upsell path to Dedicated. Regulatory timing prevents gradual ramping; they must start July-like pilot window to align with vendor certification.
- Financial impact: Base revenue reduction estimated at $9k–$11k over 90 days (see model). Upside: likely expansion to Dedicated at renewal (estimated ARR upside of $400k if conversion happens).
- Controls requested: 1) Timebox to 90 days; 2) Hard rebate cap; 3) Required Dedicated migration trigger at >300k tokens/mo; 4) Legal review of SOW (attached) and a 30-day rollback right to Redwood if material regressions are detected.
- Recommended signoff: Marissa (VP Finance) and Markus (CFO) approval for one-off exception.

Please see attached pricing model and SOW. I'm happy to adjust language; Jordan will be on the call with the customer at 2pm PT today.

Tessa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec_memo_clearwave.txt (plain text, 1 page), clearwave-pricing-model.xlsx
